decisions.reason: The message independently corrects the RR02–RR04 footer codes, and that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The page-one report-detail corrections for RR03 and RR04 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The corrected exposure level for each report variant is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Correcting report codes and variant exposure titles does not change the candidate's page-two customer-facing copy.
The candidate's structural header requirements remain unchanged; per-variant header-code values are owned by the source Requirement.
The source does not change dashboard prominence, displayed fields, heading, or visibility; variant exposure labels are represented by the variant-set Requirement.
The code corrections do not alter the report's visual-quality standard, design direction, or cross-variant design consistency.
Correcting displayed report identifiers does not change which customer-specific fields must remain editable.
The footer's style, coverage, and information categories remain unchanged; the per-variant footer-code corrections are already owned by Footer Code Consistency.
The source does not change the front-page explanation's content, bullet format, readability, or detail level.
The report-code corrections do not change the distribution warning's presence, message, visual treatment, or footer relationship.
The source does not change the vehicle-group display format or the prohibition on checkbox-style presentation.
